# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them through [GitHub's private Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/marketplace_learning_to_rank/security/advisories/new). Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and its potential impact. If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, email [work@withrana.com](mailto:work@withrana.com) with the subject “Marketplace Learning to Rank security report.”

Please do not include exploit details in public issues. The project maintainer will acknowledge reports after review and coordinate any necessary follow-up directly with the reporter.
